links.outcome: Wrong paired variant retrieved in top 5 in corpus-level ranked retrieval
links.effect: Wrong paired variant appeared in top 5 for 75% to 100% of queries under biomedical encoders over a 52-document corpus.
links.quote: In corpus-level ranked retrieval over a 52-document corpus, the wrong paired variant appeared in the top 5 for 75% to 100% of queries under the biomedical encoders.

links.outcome: Wrong-variant retrieval rate with exact-ID guardrail or typed-graph retrieval versus cosine retrieval
links.effect: Adding an exact variant-ID guardrail to cosine retrieval, and an end-to-end typed-graph pipeline, both reduced wrong-variant retrieval to zero; typed graph had 95.8% normalization accuracy.
links.quote: Adding an exact variant-ID guardrail to cosine retrieval, and routing retrieval through an end-to-end typed-graph pipeline, both reduced wrong-variant retrieval to zero.

unlisted_practices: Typed-graph retrieval with variant normalization to canonical nodes instead of vector embedding retrieval
Exact variant-ID guardrail on cosine-similarity retrieval for variant-level decision support

screen.practice: exact-ID guardrails and typed-graph retrieval grounding
screen.reason: Evaluates RAG failures (variant conflation in oncology decision support) and tests the addition of an exact variant-ID guardrail to vector retrieval as well as a typed-graph retrieval approach to prevent retrieval errors.
